title: Optimization Terminal Shortlist Pointer
description: runs/iter-N/shortlist.json (design spec 3.9's artifact table) -- the shortlist under terminal discrimination, written next to confirmation.json by orchestrator.optimize.stage_runner._finish_confirm. A DISTINCT ARTIFACT from confirmation.json, not the same record under a second name: this is a POINTER (`see`) plus the shortlist itself, so the finalists and their measurements have exactly one source of truth and a reader who only needs `who was compared and who won` does not have to parse the whole terminal record. It deliberately carries NEITHER residual_regret_terminal NOR `certified` -- the certificate and its verdict live in confirmation.json alone, so there is no second place a bound could be reported from and no way for two copies of one number to disagree.

round.description: Which terminal round this shortlist belongs to. Same value as confirmation.json's `round`.

finalists.description: The realized shortlist, carried verbatim from confirmation.json's `finalists` -- same entries, same key/levels/why/samples/mean/n/status shape.

best.description: The winning finalist's key, or null when none produced a valid measurement.

bounds.description: The per-challenger bounds against the winner, at delta_terminal with M=1 -- a screening level, not a certificate level. This is what round r+1 reads to decide who is still in contention.

epsilon.description: The resolved epsilon-optimality tolerance those bounds are read against.

see.description: Names the artifact that IS the record. Constant, because this file's whole reason for existing is to point at exactly one place rather than to become a second copy of it.
